picked_rationale.C4: C4 is the most scientifically central claim for Stage 2 verification: (1) its main-experiment evidence is the weakest (inconclusive-positive-trend, p=0.18, SAGE-lite only), making robustness testing most informative; (2) the model-swap candidate (GPT-OSS-20B + resid-post-aa) has never been run in any experiment stage — this is the 'deferred pair' from task.md and the most direct test of cross-pair generalization; (3) C4 requires both generative and predictive accuracy on a second pair, which the main experiment partially deferred; running the verify variant with GPT-OSS-20B directly addresses the central unresolved question. C1 is partial-support (significant but attribution-confounded); C2/C3 are null (under-powered nulls; swapping the model would not add new scientific insight beyond what more features would provide — scale-up is more informative than a model swap for null results).
